text:
I'm sorry, a repeat duplicate is frustrating. Our policy doesn't cover swaps, refunds or replacements for a Plant Club duplicate, so I can't promise one. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to review, so please tell me which plant it was and whether it's the same one both times.

To avoid more duplicates, you can list up to 3 plants you own under "Account" > "Subscriptions". Changes made before the 25th apply to your next box, and changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box. You can also skip, pause (up to 3 months) or change your plan there.

Would you like me to escalate?
